conf.description: ArcSight Connectors arcmc-audit, csv-file: drop the header line, CSV-extract against the full documented column schema, coerce text-typed numeric/date columns, derive event.outcome/event.kind the same way as the avro-kafka sibling, batch-rename to ECS/arcsight.arcmc.*, tag event.dataset.

conf.comment: arcsight-connectors / arcmc-audit / csv-file: rotating CSV, case-sensitive header, operator-selected columns. A File source delivers each line standalone with no cross-event header memory, so this cannot key on the live header row (same limitation as this technology's device-status csv-file pipeline). Drops the literal header line (_raw starting with 'deviceEventClassId'), then serde-CSV-extracts against an explicit fields list matching the FULL documented column schema - assumes the destination selected all these columns in this order; a deployment selecting a different subset/order will misalign (needs Source-level header handling, out of scope here, same gap as device-status). event.outcome/event.kind/label-pairing logic is identical to the avro-kafka sibling. event.severity is a direct copy of deviceSeverity: no 0-10-to-platform-numeric lookup is supplied, documented gap.

functions.description: technology/dataset/format, header-line limitation, and parsing approach
discard the literal CSV header line, which otherwise would be mis-parsed as a data row
extract the CSV row positionally against the full documented column schema
coerce text-typed CSV numeric columns, derive event.outcome/event.kind the same way as the avro-kafka sibling, compute _time/event.end - all before renaming
